title: Identification of risk features for complication in Gaucher's disease patients: a machine learning analysis of the Spanish registry of Gaucher disease.
summary: Registry includes 358 Gaucher type 1/3 patients; models identify complication-associated variables in the recorded clinical cohort.
ai_technology: Machine-learning analysis identifies clinical risk features associated with complications in the Spanish Gaucher disease registry.
organization: Grupo Español de Enfermedades de Depósito Lisosomal, Sociedad Española de Hematología y Hemoterapia, (GEEDL), Zaragoza, Spain

evidence.tested: Registry includes 358 Gaucher type 1/3 patients; models identify complication-associated variables in the recorded clinical cohort.
evidence.unknown: Results are limited to the reported models, cohorts, datasets or experiments; broader generalization and clinical or operational benefit were not established.
evidence.ai_role: Machine-learning analysis identifies clinical risk features associated with complications in the Spanish Gaucher disease registry.
